reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed: (1) getMonthlyAttendance has an active call site in AttendanceCalendar.tsx:36 (not dead code); (2) no trust_assumptions defined and the entry point is an end-user HTTP POST (untrusted); (3) src/app/actions.ts is explicitly in-scope and 'Supabase RLS bypass via admin client misuse' is a listed key concern. An attacker can trigger this via the exported 'use server' server action endpoint by sending a direct HTTP POST with any victim's Supabase UUID as the userId parameter, causing the admin-client query to bypass RLS and return the victim's full monthly attendance records (dates, check-in/out status) without authorization failure.
